title: #124 acceptance golden (health_recover.dem) never executes the #124 refill branch
detail: The refill arm needs drain==0 + any_breach + meter<100 + streak>=200. In the demo the meter stays 100 through the whole in-grace streak window (~84-984), drains while post-grace (984-1013), then !any_breach routes healing to the pre-existing recharge arm — the new branch never fires; the golden passes unchanged with the #124 code deleted.
recommended_fix: Re-author the demo so a class stays breach-latched-in-grace while a scarred meter climbs (capture the in-grace +1/tick refill), or pin the refill ticks via --stats-out evidence so the #124 golden actually exercises the #124 branch.

title: Test fixture packet_types grace left at 400 while data moved to 900 — mirror doctrine broken by this same diff
detail: This diff updates the balance.health fixture pair (mirroring 1/200) but not the per-class grace, so unit tests pin only a grace the game no longer ships — violating the file's own 'mirror the data file too' doctrine and the diff's added 'MUST carry the real values' principle, with no documenting comment.
recommended_fix: Move both fixture health_grace_ticks to 900 and re-derive the affected exact-tick pins (per the spec's 're-derive from measured runs'), or add a comment at the fixture lines documenting the deliberate 400 divergence.

title: balance.json rationale claims refill is '4× slower than the drain cap' — shipped values give 2×
evidence:
data/balance.json:47: "The issue suggested 0.25%/tick; the integer grid (ODN-10 + the u8 Meter_Changed payload) admits 1 whole-%/tick — 4× slower than the drain cap can never happen: refill only runs when drain is 0."
data/balance.json:51:
    "drain_cap_pct_per_tick": 2,
data/balance.json:56:
    "meter_refill_per_tick": 1,
detail: meter_refill_per_tick=1 vs drain_cap_pct_per_tick=2 is 2× slower, not 4× (vs the squad's observed ~1/tick drain it is 1×); 4× fits only the rejected 0.25 proposal. The real safety property — refill never coexists with drain — is code-pinned and needs no ratio.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to the true relationship (2× the cap and never coactive with drain) or drop the ratio entirely and state only the structural invariant.
